description: This file contains unit tests for DynamoDB storage provider functionality in an Orleans-based application, including read/write operations, format conversions, and serialization consistency.

classes.name: DynamoDBStorageProviderTests
classes.description: A test class that verifies the DynamoDB storage provider's functionality including read, write, format conversion, and serialization correctness.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_DynamoDB_WriteRead
methods.description: Asynchronous test method that validates writing and reading state to/from DynamoDB with optional JSON formatting.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_DynamoDB_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Asynchronous test method that verifies writing, clearing, and reading state from DynamoDB.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_DynamoDB_ChangeReadFormat
methods.description: Tests changing the read format between JSON and binary serialization in DynamoDB storage.

methods.name: PersistenceProvider_DynamoDB_ChangeWriteFormat
methods.description: Tests changing the write format between JSON and binary serialization in DynamoDB storage.

methods.name: DynamoDBStorage_ConvertToFromStorageFormat
methods.description: Verifies the conversion between in-memory state and storage format for DynamoDB.

methods.name: InitDynamoDBGrainStorage
methods.description: Initializes a DynamoDB grain storage instance with specified options.

methods.name: Test_PersistenceProvider_Read
methods.description: Tests reading state from DynamoDB and verifies correctness.

methods.name: Test_PersistenceProvider_WriteRead
methods.description: Tests writing state to DynamoDB and then reading it back to verify correctness.

methods.name: Test_PersistenceProvider_WriteClearRead
methods.description: Tests writing state, clearing it, and then verifying that the state has been reset.

methods.name: EnsureEnvironmentSupportsState
methods.description: Checks if DynamoDB is reachable; throws if not.
